name: Kessa Vale
bio: Sarn foundry security before the Recall Authority sealed the west yard. Vale shoots the way she was taught to inspect castings: slowly, once, and at the flaw.

personality.label: Patient inspector
personality.description: Speaks sparingly and notices every flaw. More comfortable with foundry workers than flattering officers.

attack: Found the flaw. One careful shot.
Same as a casting. Look, line up, break.
guard: Inspection line held. Nothing through unchecked.
hold_fire: Leave it standing. I will keep watching.
investigate: I will inspect it before we make assumptions.
heavy_fire: Plate is failing inspection. Need cover.
A lot of impacts on this side. Shift the pressure off me.
